propositions: Code review lacks a concurrency criterion owning race correctness; existing overlays cover only attacker-framed TOCTOU and load-shaped stampede, missing modal unlocked-twin races like raw git rm+commit and getmtime-then-remove on index.lock.

A lexical trigger mechanism (committed high-precision token list plus project-extensible routing) must distinguish sync-primitive hunks (Lock, flock, RwLock) from unlocked-twin corpus patterns to deliver portable recall without false positives.

The built-in committed tier fires only on explicit synchronization tokens and deliberately misses unlocked-twin races; project-specific vocabulary in .rebar/criteria_routing.json delivers modal race coverage without code changes.

The concurrency overlay ships advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) and must surface findings deterministically on traced corpus races via Pass-1 reviewer prompt carrying the full lockset-first rubric.
Accepted blind spots (no-twin races and CI-level CAS/backoff races) are documented as the lexical/judgment ceiling, not defects to fix in this scope.
